answer: Pay defectors. Each identity's rewards vest in escrow for several epochs, and anyone who proves that a set of identities shares one controller (a common funding anchor, a reused signing path, a planted canary that leaks across them) claims a cut of that set's escrow. Every sybil head then has a standing reason to betray its farm, so big rings rot from inside, while honest loners have nothing to confess. Perfect detection, an ivory-tower ideal, becomes a relic: we only need collusion to be unstable.
